overlays.roleBrief: Hands-on serial assembly worker responsible for repeated structural sections and common interfaces.
overlays.statusReadability: Qualification patch, inspected tools and work-zone responsibility, not decorative rank.
overlays.practicalGear: Torque tools, inspection tablet, safety tether and standardized workwear.
overlays.condition: Clean production wear with localized handling marks.

overlays.roleBrief: Fleet maintenance specialist trained across common engine, sensor and service assemblies.
overlays.statusReadability: Higher certification shown by calibrated diagnostic equipment and controlled access markings.
overlays.practicalGear: Diagnostic rig, service keys, spare-interface gauges and protective gloves.
overlays.condition: Operational grime limited to service zones; equipment remains maintained.

overlays.roleBrief: Production engineer coordinating line balance, tolerances and controlled changeovers.
overlays.statusReadability: Responsibility reads through precision instruments, authorization tabs and cleaner technical layers.
overlays.practicalGear: Line tablet, tolerance gauges, headset and modular tool roll.
overlays.condition: Tired during changeover work but technically composed.

overlays.roleBrief: Ship or fleet officer responsible for maintainable standardized task groups.
overlays.statusReadability: Command responsibility through functional cut, data access and restrained qualification marks.
overlays.practicalGear: Fleet terminal, comms interface and practical pressure-ready uniform.
overlays.condition: No ceremonial excess; field variant may show fatigue.

overlays.roleBrief: Coordinator of bulk freight, tanker windows, stockpile coverage and route capacity.
overlays.statusReadability: Status through route authority credentials and high-grade planning equipment.
overlays.practicalGear: Cargo manifest tablet, comms, route overlays and handling-zone PPE.

overlays.roleBrief: Plant director or technical administrator accountable for throughput, safety and contractual access.
overlays.statusReadability: Highest responsibility shown through material quality, clean fit and senior certification, not luxury ornament.
overlays.practicalGear: Secure terminal, inspection credentials and minimal supervisory gear.
overlays.condition: Controlled fatigue during crisis; no aristocratic signals.

overlays.roleBrief: Field repair specialist restoring damaged standardized sections under constrained supply.
overlays.statusReadability: Competence through improvised-but-standard-compatible equipment and visible qualification markings.
overlays.practicalGear: Portable diagnostic kit, patch panels, tether, spare connectors and protective layers.
overlays.condition: Damaged/tired variant: soot and abrasion localized to work surfaces without post-apocalyptic styling.
